title: WPSS/1781/2012 of SUBHASH CHANDRA GHANSELA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1781 of 2012
Subhash Chandra Ghansela Ö Petitioner
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö Respondents
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Ms. Puja Banga, Brief Holder, present for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Advocate, present for respondent No. 4.
Honíble Kalyan Jyoti Sengupta, J. (Oral)
Delay Condonation Application No. 3901 of 2013
 The delay condonation application, for taking rejoinder
affidavit on record, is allowed. The rejoinder affidavit is taken on
record.
WPSS No. 1781 of 2012
 In this writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the
advertisement issued for filling up of the posts of Lecturers in
Intermediate College.
 The petitioner case is that the advertisement issued
contrary to the existing rules as by the proposed advertisement, all
the posts are sought to be filled up by direct recruitment. Under
the relevant rules, these posts are to be filled up by way of
promotion and direct recruitment both. 50 per cent quota has
been reserved for promotion. Learned counsel for the petitioner
states that the petitioner is entitled to and further eligible to be
promoted to the post of Lecturer.
 In the counter affidavit, it is not disputed that 50 per
cent of the posts are required to be filled up by way of promotion.
However, it is asserted that petitioner has not acquired
qualification to get promotion as he has not put in five years
continuous services in the feeder post.
 After hearing learned counsel for the parties and after
considering the material, it appears to me that only question in this
case arises whether petitioner is acquired qualification to get

2
promotion or not. The rules provide that five years is to be counted
reckoning the date of occurring of vacancy. In this case, the
vacancy has occurred due to retirement on 30th June, 2012.
Hence, vacancy occurred on 1st July, 2012. It appears that the
petitioner joined the feeder post on 2nd July, 2007. Therefore, after
calculating the number of days, it appears to me that the petitioner
has fulfilled just five years or may be less than one day going by
month wise. If it is calculated day wise, the petitioner has already
fulfilled five years continuous services. Therefore, little bit of
benefit of doubt should be given to the petitioner. Accordingly, I
direct the respondents to grant promotion to the petitioner in the
suitable post as per the qualification and rest of the posts may be
filed up by way of promotion, as no other person comes forward to
challenge it. Therefore, interim order stands vacated. Stay
vacation application (No. 316 of 2013) stands disposed of.
 Steps may be taken by both ways i.e. by promotion in
terms of the order and by direct recruitment as early as possible.
Promotion shall be granted to the petitioner within a period of one
month from the date of communication of this order.
 Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed.
